scripts.db:setup: npm run db:setup -w job-portal-api && npm run db:setup -w campus-placement-api
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed -w job-portal-api && npm run db:seed -w campus-placement-api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n jobs,campus -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w job-portal-api" "npm run start:dev -w campus-placement-api"
scripts.start: concurrently -n jobs,campus -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w job-portal-api" "npm run start:prod -w campus-placement-api"
